text:
mohit: New hire hit onboarding wall during key rotation. They swapped REDWOOD_API_KEY and suddenly sampleapp started throwing 401s.
alana: Any extra detail? 401 alone is rough.
mohit: App log: `401 Unauthorized` and nothing else. They had REDWOOD_PROJECT_NAME set in their dotfiles; CI injects REDWOOD_PROJECT. App read REDWOOD_PROJECT_NAME and sent no project scope header.
peter: So mismatch again between env names + rotation. We should add a small diagnostic header from server like `x-redwood-expected-scope: project` and `x-redwood-provided-scope: none` when rejecting.
julia: Agreed. Also proposal: add a startup warning in SDKs if a deprecated env var is present. e.g., when REDWOOD_PROJECT_NAME is present, print a single-line deprecation hint: "DEPRECATION: REDWOOD_PROJECT_NAME will be removed; set REDWOOD_PROJECT or run `redwood doctor`".
mohit: I like `redwood doctor` idea — a tiny CLI that validates env var consistency and detects common onboarding gotchas (missing project, dotfile overrides, multiple project vars).
alana: Implementation plan: (1) SDKs accept both env names for now, preferring REDWOOD_PROJECT. (2) Emit one-time startup warning if only REDWOOD_PROJECT_NAME is present. (3) Treat 401/403 as non-retry unless `Retry-After` or `x-redwood-retryable-auth: true` present. (4) Add server headers per peter.
peter: For rotation edgecases: CI sometimes injects ephemeral keys during rollout; if SDK retries on 401 it can mask short windows and create noisy logs. Explicit non-retry makes the failure obvious.
julia: For onboarding unblock: I'll PR a tiny CLI `redwood doctor` in devex repo that checks env precedence and prints fixes. Also patch sampleapp README to include clear env precedence and example `export REDWOOD_PROJECT=demo` snippet.
mohit: Can we also add a one-line sampleapp startup check that fails early: `if api_key && not project -> exit 1` with message linking to `redwood doctor`? New hires will thank us.
ops: CI note: I'll add onboarding gate that runs `redwood doctor` as part of the smoke job. If `redwood doctor` fails, fail fast and point to onboarding doc.
dev-tools-bot: CI: onboarding-doctor #12 queued.
ajulia: Followups: julia will PR `redwood doctor` + sampleapp check today; peter files backend ticket for diagnostic headers; mohit to add CHANGES note about env fallback and deprecation warning.
mohit: Thanks. Quick timeline: docs + doctor today, SDK runtime parity + retry change in next patch release.
alana: Also record a short troubleshooting snippet in onboarding playbook: "If 401 + `x-redwood-expected-scope: project` -> ensure you export REDWOOD_PROJECT and restart (or run `redwood doctor`)."
mohit: Closing loop once CI smoke job passes. Thanks all.
